cues: Now corrosion, and our cold open.
Rusting needs both water and oxygen, and it is electrochemical.
A drop of water on iron becomes a tiny galvanic cell.
The centre of the drop, short of oxygen, is the anode: iron dissolves as iron two ions, leaving electrons behind.
